name: Deseo Lúcido
source: You start having lucid dreams about your attractive neighbour, Saya. By day, your relationship slowly grows; by night, convinced it’s all just a dream, you let yourself indulge in your hottest fantasies with her and do almost anything you want… but Saya starts acting a little too real.
translation: You start having lucid dreams about your attractive neighbour, Saya. By day, your relationship slowly grows; by night, convinced it’s all just a dream, you let yourself indulge in your hottest fantasies with her and do almost anything you want… but Saya starts acting a little too real.
